errors.evidence: The description states there are seven tasks, but the x-axis clearly shows eight distinct categories (FinFE, FinQA, FinNA, FinRE, FinNSP1, FinNSP2, FinNL, and AVG).

The description states the y-axis range is from 0 to 80. While the axis labels go up to 80, some data points exceed this value, with the highest bar (K-Center-Greedy in FinNSP1) reaching approximately 91.
The description claims the unit of the y-axis is '分' (points/score), but the y-axis in the figure has no units specified.
